LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkTrue: The master of {FACTION} judged {PAWN_nameDef}'s {THING} true work and put the guild's mark on it. The guild will speak well of {PAWN_objective} for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkTrueExpert: The master of {FACTION} judged {PAWN_nameDef}'s {THING} true work and put the guild's mark on it. The guild will speak well of {PAWN_objective} for it, and {PAWN_nameDef} came away with the quality expertise.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkFault: The master of {FACTION} found a fault in {PAWN_nameDef}'s {THING} and would not put the guild's mark on it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkTrueBack: I knew it was good, but it's something to hear it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkTrueBack_2: Thank you, that means a great deal.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkTrueBack_3: I'll make the next one better still.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkFaultBack: I didn't see it until you showed me.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkFaultBack_2: You're right, and I hate that you're right.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MarkFaultBack_3: Then I'll do it again, properly.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PieceGone: The {0} isn't at the colony now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Judge: The master goes to the {1} where it is and looks it over for an hour, with {0} beside them
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_MarkTrue: If it is true work: the guild's mark, {0} +6 mood for 20 days, and the guild speaks well of {0}
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_MarkTrueExpert: If it is true work: the guild's mark, {0} +6 mood for 20 days, the guild speaks well of {0}, and {0} gets the quality expertise (Vanilla Skills Expanded)
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_MarkFault: About one masterwork in five has a fault the master finds: then {0} -5 mood for 8 days
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_MarkFaultLegend: About one legendary piece in twelve has a fault the master finds: then {0} -5 mood for 8 days
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_MarkFaultBrief: a fault found: a bad memory
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_JudgeLesson: {0} learns {1} from the master as they go over it together
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_markTrue: had a piece judged true work by the guild
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_markTrue_Name: made {NAME}, judged true work by the guild
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_markTrue_Many: had pieces judged true work by the guild, {COUNT} times
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_MakerAway: {0} isn't at home to see them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Gift: {0} leaves the colony a masterwork {1} of their own making
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WhereWater: over the water nearest the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WhereMiddle: in the open by the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkStoneCame: The colony's {THING} has been carried out to the journeymen, and they are back at {WORK}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkShort: {X_nameDef} of the journeymen says the work is waiting: the colony's stores don't hold the {COUNT} {THING} it still needs. They will wait a day or two for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkMakeDo: The journeymen have waited long enough for the stone, and will finish {WORK} with what they were given. It will be a grade plainer.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkCracked: A block cracked at the journeymen's work, and {X_nameDef} says it needs {COUNT} more {THING} from the colony's stores.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkTorn: {X_nameDef} looked over {THING}'s day of work on {WORK}, judged it bad and had it torn down. It costs them a day.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkStands: The journeymen of {FACTION} have finished {WORK}. {PAWN}'s name is cut into it as the guild's mark, and it is the colony's.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkUnfinished: The journeymen of {FACTION} have gone with their work unfinished. The stone they were given is left where they were working, for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WorkNoStone: The colony's stores don't hold enough {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Camp_End_nostone: The {NAME} from {FACTION} waited for the colony's stone and none came, so they packed up their camp {PLACE} and left without starting the work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Work: Three journeymen of {0} camp by the colony for five to eight days and build {1}; once they have camped, the stone is carried out to them from the stores
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_WorkBrief: a camp and a great work
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_WorkTurns: It can turn: a cracked block needs up to {0} more {1} (without it they wait a day or two, then make do), or a day's bad work is torn down
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_WorkBeside: {0} works beside them through their working hours and learns
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Radio_goods: {PAWN_nameDef} has called for a trader of goods on the colony's radio. A caravan is on its way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Radio_arms: {PAWN_nameDef} has called for a trader of arms on the colony's radio. A caravan is on its way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Radio_hands: {PAWN_nameDef} has put out word on the colony's radio that the colony takes in people.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Radio_word: {PAWN_nameDef} has made the colony's call on its radio, asking the Line to speak well of it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Runner_goods: {PAWN_nameDef} has set off with the colony's call for a trader of goods, to pass it on from the Line's next post.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Runner_arms: {PAWN_nameDef} has set off with the colony's call for a trader of arms, to pass it on from the Line's next post.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Runner_hands: {PAWN_nameDef} has set off with word that the colony takes in people, to pass it on from the Line's next post.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Runner_word: {PAWN_nameDef} has set off with the colony's call, to have the Line speak well of it from the next post.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_WordSaid: The Line has spoken well of the colony to {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_Unanswered: The Line's call for the colony went unanswered: nobody could come now. The Line is sending the {COUNT} silver back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_NoTrader: No people at peace with the colony sends that kind of trader.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Call_NoWord: There is nobody the colony needs a good word with.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CallTraderRadio: The operator makes the call on the colony's radio, and a {0} of {1} comes within hours
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CallTraderRunner: The runner carries the call to the Line's next post, and a {0} of {1} comes in a day or two
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CallHandsRadio: The operator makes the call on the colony's radio, and someone looking for a place comes to join within hours
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CallHandsRunner: The runner carries the call to the Line's next post, and someone looking for a place comes to join in a day or two
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CallWordRadio: The operator makes the call on the colony's radio, and the Line speaks well of the colony to {0}
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CallWordRunner: The runner carries the call to the Line's next post, and the Line speaks well of the colony to {0} in a day or two
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_TownMastUp: The lineman of {FACTION} has raised the Line's mast at {TOWN}. From now the colony's letters to {NAME} there, and the answers, take half the days on the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_TownMastLost: {TOWN} is gone, and the Line's mast there with it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_TownMast: The lineman walks to {0} and raises a mast there; a message says when it stands
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_TownMastLetters: The colony's letters to {0} at {1}, and the answers, take half the days on the road while the Line is at peace with the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewMastUp: {X_nameDef} and the line crew have raised their radio mast by their fire. While it stands, the colony's letters go out by their wire.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewTowerUp: {X_nameDef} and the line crew have put up their signal tower by their fire. While it stands, the colony's letters are passed along by signal.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewFell: {X_nameDef} of the line crew fell from the mast in the storm and hurt {X_possessive} {THING}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewMastStruck: Lightning struck the line crew's mast and broke it. They will raise another once the storm has passed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewTowerStruck: Lightning struck the line crew's signal tower and broke it. They will put up another once the storm has passed.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewRadioNews: On the line crew's radio at their fire tonight, {X_nameDef} heard this news: {THING}
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewFlagsNews: {X_nameDef} read this news from the next tower's lamps tonight: {THING}
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewMastKept: The line crew has left its radio mast standing on the high ground. It is the colony's relay mast now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_CrewFed: Their food for the week went with them from the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_KeepTower: A signal tower needs the Line's watchers, so it goes with them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_KeepAlready: The colony is keeping the mast already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_KeepHave: The colony has a relay mast of its own.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Crew: A crew of {0} camps a week on {1} and raises a {2} there
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CrewBrief: a camp on the high ground
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CrewLetters: While it stands the colony's letters take half the days on the road, and once a night they pass on the region's news, and the places it names are marked as heard of
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_CrewTurns: It can turn in a thunderstorm: a lineman may fall from the mast, or the lightning may break it
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_KeepMast: When they go the mast stays, as the colony's own relay mast
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PitBothCantGo: The colony can't spare both of them now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PitThere: {PAWN_nameDef} has reached the pit at {PLACE} and gone down to dig with the miners of {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PitCrush: Word from the pit at {PLACE}: a fall of rock caught {PAWN_nameDef}'s {PART} on the {SHIFT} shift. The union's medic bound it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PitCrushDoctor: Word from the pit at {PLACE}: a fall of rock caught {PAWN_nameDef}'s {PART} on the {SHIFT} shift. {DOCTOR} bound it there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PitHome: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from the pit at {PLACE} with the union's pay of {PAY} silver. The trapped miners of {FACTION} were dug out.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PitHomeEarly: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from the pit at {PLACE} before the digging was done.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Pit: {0} set out for {1} on the roads, and dig there for {2} days, a shift a day
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PitPay: The union's pay: {0} silver each, brought home
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PitRisk: One shift in twenty a fall of rock may crush a foot or a hand of {0} (once each at most), as at the union's drill
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PitRiskBrief: a crush, at the drill's rate
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Dir_North: to the north of the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Dir_South: to the south of the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Dir_East: to the east of the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Dir_West: to the west of the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_OilGone: The ground where they found the oil can't take a well now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WellSunk: The assayer of {FACTION} has sunk a {THING} for the colony. It is the colony's now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_WellSunkShare: The assayer of {FACTION} has sunk a {THING} for the colony. It is the colony's now, and the union will collect {COUNT} chemfuel a season for a year.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_SeamMarked: The assayer of {FACTION} has marked a seam of {ORE} here, about {COUNT} of it. The union's drill crew will come for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_ShareFuel: {FACTION} takes its share of the well this season: {COUNT} chemfuel from the colony's stores. Shares left: {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_ShareSilver: The stores were short of chemfuel, so {FACTION} takes its share of the well in silver this season: {SILVER} silver. Shares left: {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_ShareLetGo: The stores held neither the chemfuel nor the silver for {FACTION}'s share of the well this season, and the union let it go. Shares left: {LEFT}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Well: The assayer and the driller drill for six hours {1}, and a {0} stands there, the colony's
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_WellShare: The union collects {0} chemfuel a season for {1} seasons, or its worth in silver when the stores are short
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Seam: The assayer marks the seam of {0} {1}, and the union's drill crew comes for it a day later
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_SeamWalk: {0} walks the ground with the assayer and learns mining
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PetitionLift: After the shift-captain's talk at the fire, {PAWN_nameDef} asks the council to lift {DECREE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PetitionRest: After the shift-captain's talk at the fire, {PAWN_nameDef} asks the council for {DECREE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PetitionGranted: The council granted the petition {PAWN_nameDef} brought after the shift-captain's talk. Those worn down are glad of it, and {FACTION} thinks better of the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PetitionRefused: The council let the petition {PAWN_nameDef} brought after the shift-captain's talk go unanswered. Those worn down are stung by it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PetitionLift: The next morning, the one most worn down asks the council to lift {0}
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PetitionRest: The next morning, the one most worn down asks the council for {0}
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PetitionEither: Granted: those worn down +4 mood for 6 days, and the union thinks better of the colony. Refused or left to lapse: those worn down -4 mood for 6 days
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_PicketNoMiner: The colony has no miner to send.
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_Picket: Strikers of {0} camp by the colony's road while the strike lasts, and their shift-captain settles it with the colony there
LanguageData.CC_PEv7_Impact_PicketTurns: It can turn: strikebreakers may come against their camp
